name: CONTAGION
text: For the turning point, an enemy suffers Move -2 inches and worse Hit (like an injured operative, never doubled) while it is within 3 inches of a friendly Plague Marine and visible either way and carries one of your Poison tokens, or is within 3 inches of a friendly Icon Bearer and visible either way.

name: LUMBERING DEATH
text: For the turning point, a friendly Plague Marine's weapons have Ceaseless while it shoots or fights in an activation where it has moved 3 inches or less in total (climbing and Accessible terrain included), and whenever it retaliates.

name: CLOUD OF FLIES
text: Place a Cloud of Flies marker in the killzone. A friendly Plague Marine wholly within 1 inch of it is obscured against shooters more than 3 inches away. The marker is removed in the Ready step of the next Strategy phase.

name: NURGLINGS
text: Pick an enemy within 3 inches of a friendly Plague Marine, or an enemy with one of your Poison tokens within 7 inches of one (no visibility needed). It has 1 less APL until the end of its next activation.

name: VIRULENT POISON
text: During a friendly Plague Marine's activation or counteraction, before or after one of its actions: an enemy within 3 inches of it (no visibility needed), or visible to it and within 7 inches, gains one of your Poison tokens if it has none.

name: SICKENING RESILIENCE
text: When attack dice are about to damage a friendly Plague Marine: until the end of the activation or counteraction, Disgustingly Resilient on that operative needs no roll and always takes 1 off the damage of a die (3 or more), never below 2.

name: POISONOUS DEMISE
text: When a friendly Plague Marine is incapacitated, before it is removed: each enemy visible to it within 3 inches gains one of your Poison tokens, or takes 1 damage instead if it already has one (including one gained earlier in the same action). The engine plays this for you when you can pay.

name: CURSE OF ROT
text: A friendly Plague Marine shoots or fights (not retaliating) an enemy within 3 inches, or within 7 inches if that enemy carries one of your Poison tokens: every die of 3 the opponent rolls deals 1 damage to that enemy, cannot be kept as a success and cannot be re-rolled. When shooting you name it with your attack dice and it takes effect on the defence roll.
